title: AJO 2.0B – Dairy GI 35 and Fruit GI 51 source impact review

primaryArticle.citation: Atkinson et al. International tables of glycemic index and glycemic load values 2021: a systematic review. AJCN 2021;114:1625–1632. DOI 10.1093/ajcn/nqab233.
primaryArticle.scale: Table 1 category means are glucose-reference values aggregated from food-specific entries. Individual entries include human GI tests, with their food form and scale in the source table; category means are not a human test of the recipe ingredient.

dairy.decision: Do not accept as a general GI for all unflavoured dairy. Keep as source/reference evidence pending a narrowly specified policy; category is heterogeneous and does not establish GI for cream, cream cheese, cottage cheese/quark, ricotta, feta, halloumi, Greek/Turkish yogurt or plain yogurt individually. The 186 observations aggregate materially different products: milks, yogurt/kefir, flavored products, ice creams, desserts and other dairy foods. A direct product-specific GI can only be claimed for entries actually listed and matched by form; no recipe-specific source was established in this review.
dairy.sourceScale: GLUCOSE_100 at category summary; heterogeneous individual source methods must be checked per item.
dairy.historicalDirectEvidence: Supplemental Table 1 reports food-specific human measurements for products such as full-fat milk and various dairy desserts/ice creams. These establish those tested items only, not generic cream/cheese/quark.

fruit.decision: Do not accept as GI for arbitrary fruits or preparations. The 105 entries combine distinct raw, cooked, canned, dried, juiced, pureed and mixed forms; mean is not an individual food test or preparation match. Retain only as reference, while seeking exact food/form evidence for each binding.
fruit.sourceScale: GLUCOSE_100 category summary; inspect individual entry for food-specific scale and preparation.

strawberry.source: 2021 Supplemental Table 1 entry 1174; footnote indicates unpublished Sydney observations.
strawberry.decision: Potential exact form match for the raw strawberries in vhh-brita-kakku, but underlying observations are unpublished. Do not count as accepted project evidence absent explicit policy approval; does not validate cake/mixed preparations.

conflicts: Fruit catalog metadata says fruit-category-mean and notes a broad tamarind-paste analogue, while the other current bindings apply it to lemon juice, frozen berry mix, strawberry, fig and canned peach slices. This is internally contradictory and never supports those separate preparation matches.

Dairy record preparation metadata says plain cream cheese while active assignments include cream, yogurt, cottage cheese, milk, feta, ricotta and halloumi. The category label conceals these unmatched transfers.
All category mean values are group aggregates; category standard deviations are not per-recipe uncertainty intervals. LOW confidence does not establish identity.
